entry.title: New: Resolution 720 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO ALA KAHAKAI TRAIL ASSOCIATION

Approves a grant of $173,500 to Ala Kahakai Trail Association, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to develop a community resource management plan for the Kiolaka‘a, Ka‘ū, property (Tax Map Keys: 9-4-001:008, 009, 016, 017, and 023), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
